final: SELECT COALESCE(p.bats, '') as batting_hand, COUNT(DISTINCT m.player_id) as distinct_managers, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT m.player_id) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m2.player_id) FROM manager_award m2 INNER JOIN player p2 ON m2.player_id = p2.player_id) as share FROM manager_award m INNER JOIN player p ON m.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.bats, '') ORDER BY batting_hand
